senses.definition_en: to settle down, put down roots

examples.english: "Entanarse" isn't simply sitting and watching. It's not just passing the time. It's not just wandering or loitering. "Entanarse" is stopping, disconnecting, letting time slip away by the sea or in any corner of the autonomous city that invites calm. It's an act sometimes solitary, sometimes shared, but always Melillan.
examples.ref: 2025 August 1, “‘ENTANARSE’, EL VERBO QUE NO ESTÁ EN EL DICCIONARIO PERO QUE ENCUENTRAS EN CADA RINCÓN DE MELILLA”, in Cronistas Oficiales, archived from the original on 04 Aug 2025:
examples.text: ‘Entanarse’ no es simplemente sentarse a mirar. No es pasar el rato. No es vagar ni vaguear. ‘Entanarse’ es detenerse, desconectar, dejar que el tiempo se vaya frente al mar o en cualquier rincón de la ciudad autónoma que invite a la calma. Es un acto a veces solitario, a veces compartido, pero siempre melillense.
examples.translation: "Entanarse" isn't simply sitting and watching. It's not just passing the time. It's not just wandering or loitering. "Entanarse" is stopping, disconnecting, letting time slip away by the sea or in any corner of the autonomous city that invites calm. It's an act sometimes solitary, sometimes shared, but always Melillan.

glosses: to settle down, put down roots
